methodology.cold: Fresh Chromium context for each route/run, empty browser/app caches, same deterministic data fixture; host process and browser binary stay warm
methodology.readiness: Visible numeric primary data; existing performanceOutcome excludes unavailable, empty and error placeholders; optional sections do not delay detail price
methodology.percentiles: p50 is median; p95 is nearest rank. With 5 or 10 samples p95 equals sample maximum; no production percentile or SLA claim
methodology.networking: All data endpoints fulfilled by tests/e2e/data.mjs payloadFor. Only the selected loopback origin may continue. No live providers, telemetry or LLM APIs
methodology.runtime: Anonymous web preview: SDK runtime is false and native analytics remains inactive. No user identity, query, credentials, notes or real interest list is collected
methodology.requestCounts: Path-only counts from navigation to primary readiness plus diagnostic capture; requestCountAtPrimary records the boundary; observed response bodies complete without fixed sleeps
methodology.bytes: Initial entry JS comes from the built dist; response SHA must match. Local gzip comparison is not observed wire transfer or total loaded-resource bytes
limits: Local desktop Chromium viewport, not Android/iOS native Toss
No mobile network/CPU throttling or server cold start
50ms readiness polling and host scheduling can move small latency differences
No fixed wait or network-idle barrier; optional requests initiated after primary capture may be outside counts and optional bodies can remain pending/null
Playwright routing disables HTTP cache identically in both builds
Fixed fixture Date uses Playwright clock, which substitutes browser Performance/timers; elapsed primary-readiness time is measured by real Node performance.now, resource timing is unavailable
Readiness validates primary data presence rather than every optional section or every fixture value

sourceRevisionMeaning: Git HEAD identifies the base commit; sourceTreeSha256 identifies measured application/config working-tree contents and distTreeSha256 identifies all built artifacts

initialJavaScript.gzipMeaning: node:zlib default gzip; build artifact comparison, not observed wire transfer
